scripts.build: pnpm run build:site && pnpm run build:tech-docs
scripts.build:site: node scripts/general/check-sharp.js && next build site --webpack && node scripts/general/prepare-standalone.cjs
scripts.release:gate: pnpm run release:gate:core && pnpm run test:browser:gate
scripts.release:gate:core: pnpm run check:layout && pnpm run verify:focss && pnpm run test:audit && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:ui:strict && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:coverage:site && pnpm run test:coverage:admin && pnpm run check:docs-all && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run check:style-tokens && pnpm run check:governance && pnpm run scan:secrets
scripts.release:gate:fast: node scripts/general/prune-site-dumps.mjs && pnpm run check:layout && pnpm run verify:focss && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run p0:unit && pnpm run test:priority-7 && pnpm run test:priority-8 && pnpm run test:audit:fast && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:ui:strict && pnpm run check:ui-assets && pnpm run check:launch && pnpm run check:docs-all && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run check:style-tokens && pnpm run check:governance && pnpm run scan:secrets
scripts.check:docs-all: node scripts/general/check-repo-layout.mjs && node scripts/general/check-failures.mjs && node scripts/general/check-agents-md.mjs && node scripts/general/check-agents-folder.mjs && node scripts/general/check-active-docs.mjs && node scripts/general/check-plans-purity.mjs && node scripts/general/check-docs-purity.mjs && node scripts/general/check-root-markdown-links.mjs
scripts.check:launch: node scripts/general/validate-launch-env.mjs && node scripts/general/scan_secrets.mjs && pnpm exec tsx scripts/db_test_connection.ts
scripts.check:site-ui: node scripts/check-site-ui-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n-key-parity.mjs && node scripts/check-homepage-dialect.mjs
scripts.test:coverage:admin: pnpm exec vitest run --coverage --config tests/vitest.admin.coverage.config.ts && node scripts/generate-coverage-report.mjs admin
scripts.p0:unit: pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts --outputFile.json=../results/tests/vitest-p0-results.json tests/unit/lib/auth/devAuthBypass.test.ts tests/unit/planner tests/unit/studio
scripts.test:priority-7: pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts --outputFile.json=../results/tests/vitest-priority-7-results.json tests/unit/app/api/admin/_lib/server.test.ts tests/unit/lib/storage/r2Catalog.test.ts tests/integration/features/ops/CustomerQueriesOpsPageView.test.tsx tests/unit/features/ops/CustomerQueriesOpsPageView.test.tsx tests/unit/lib/catalog/publish
scripts.test:priority-8: pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts --outputFile.json=../results/tests/vitest-priority-8-results.json "tests/unit/app/(site)/robots.test.ts" "tests/unit/app/(site)/sitemap.test.ts" tests/unit/features/site/data/routeMetadata.test.ts tests/unit/features/site/data/seo.test.ts tests/unit/features/site/data/seoStandardsAudit.test.ts tests/unit/features/site/data/siteSeoAcceptance.test.ts tests/unit/lib/seo/indexnow.test.ts tests/unit/site/proxy.test.ts tests/unit/app/api/csrf/route.test.ts tests/unit/features/shared/api/withAuth.test.ts tests/unit/lib/auth/devAuthBypass.test.ts tests/unit/lib/rateLimit.test.ts tests/unit/lib/security/csrf.test.ts tests/unit/scripts/generate-svg/sanitize.test.ts tests/unit/scripts/scan_secrets.test.ts tests/unit/lib/env.server.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: cross-env NODE_ENV=test DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=true pnpm run test:clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=true pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts --coverage && node scripts/generate-coverage-report.mjs planner && node scripts/generate-vitest-report.mjs results/tests/vitest-results.json
scripts.test:coverage:site: cross-env NODE_ENV=test DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=true pnpm run test:clean && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=true pnpm exec vitest run --coverage --config tests/vitest.site.config.ts && node scripts/generate-coverage-report.mjs site && node scripts/generate-vitest-report.mjs results/tests/vitest-site-results.json
scripts.test:a11y: pnpm run test:clean && pnpm exec playwright test -c config/build/playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.test:planner-catalog: pnpm run test:clean && pnpm exec playwright test -c config/build/playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/admin-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-catalog.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-guest-workspace.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-custom-tools.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-chrome.spec.ts tests/e2e/sketch-to-plan-pipeline.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-offline-sync.spec.ts
scripts.audit:visual: cross-env DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=1 pnpm exec playwright test -c config/build/playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/visual-audit-full-site.spec.ts && node scripts/generate-visual-audit-report.mjs
